response:
I'm sorry you're dealing with this. Depression can feel exhausting and make even basic tasks overwhelming, so it makes sense that work and daily activities feel difficult right now.

Some things that may help include starting with very small, manageable goals rather than expecting too much of yourself. Gentle movement, maintaining a basic routine, and reaching out to someone you trust can sometimes ease the weight a little. Be patient with yourself—progress isn't linear.

Consider speaking with a mental health professional who can help you explore what's contributing to these feelings and discuss treatment options that fit your situation. If you're in crisis or having thoughts of self-harm, please reach out to emergency services or a crisis line like 988 (in the US) right away. You don't have to navigate this alone, and support is available.
